newsitem.title: JAPAN: Dollar steady, clinging near 115.70 yen in Tokyo.
newsitem.headline: Dollar steady, clinging near 115.70 yen in Tokyo.

text.p: *Dollar steady against yen in early Tokyo, clinging near 115.70 yen, with some light bids detected, probably from U.S. securities firms.

*Also possibility of some light speculative buying in attempt to trigger stop-loss buying orders around 116 yen. But talk of exporter selling interest above that level appeared to be inhibiting gains for now.
*Some commercial buying before 0100 GMT local fixing possible, but amount not expected to be large, dealers said.

*Russian President Boris Yeltsin's hospitalisation not expected to have strong impact on Tokyo dollar/mark trade on Thursday, with market attention focused instead on Bundesbank council meeting and announcement at 0855 GMT of German December unemployment figures.
